clusters.headline: MPR To Verify Amran And Sugiono As Vice President Candidates
aiSummaryBullets: The MPR is verifying the credentials of Andi Amran Sulaiman and Sugiono through the Ministry of Basic and Secondary Education.
President Prabowo Subianto proposed both candidates to replace Gibran, with a final selection set for December 11 via voting or consensus.

clusters.headline: Police Identify One Victim Of The PT Fonusa Agung Mulia Fire
aiSummaryBullets: Authorities have successfully identified one victim of the fire at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia candy factory in Cikande, Banten.
Police are conducting DNA testing to identify the remaining 25 victims, a process expected to conclude within four days.

clusters.headline: Kejaksaan Agung Tugaskan 32 Jaksa Tangani Kasus Listyo Sigit Cs
aiSummaryBullets: The Attorney General's Office has designated 32 prosecutors to oversee the legal files concerning former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo.
Bareskrim investigators identified a civilian suspect linked to the alleged illegal wiretapping operations conducted by Listyo Sigit and his associates.

clusters.headline: Listyo Sigit Required To Attend Ethics Trial In Person On Thursday
aiSummaryBullets: Former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo is required to attend his ethics trial in person on November 26, 2026.
The ethics hearing concerns allegations of illegal wiretapping and treason directed toward President Prabowo Subianto.

clusters.headline: Erin Wartia Trigina Named Suspect And Reaches Settlement With ART
aiSummaryBullets: Rien Wartia Trigina was named a suspect in an investigation regarding alleged abuse of a former housekeeper.
The legal case initially carried a potential two-year prison sentence before both parties agreed to a settlement.

clusters.headline: KPK Investigates BNPB Disaster Fund Corruption and Fee Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: The KPK is examining allegations of direct procurement and illicit fee payments involving disaster funds at the BNPB.
Investigators have called the wife and children of former BNPB head Suharyanto as witnesses, though they did not appear for questioning.

clusters.headline: Brigjen Tedjo Kusumo Dismissed From Police Over Treason Case
aiSummaryBullets: Brigjen Tedjo Kusumo was dishonorably discharged from the Indonesian National Police following a professional code of ethics hearing.
Investigations allege the former officer orchestrated surveillance on government officials while serving as a Director of Intelligence in Densus 88.

clusters.headline: Polri Fires AKBP Guntur Yayus Putra for Role in Alleged Treason Case
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian National Police (Polri) has officially dismissed AKBP Guntur Yayus Putra from duty.
The dismissal follows investigations into his alleged involvement in a treason case and the unauthorized surveillance of government officials.

clusters.headline: Mendagri Tito Karnavian Urges Digital Child Protection Measures
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian highlights the importance of protecting children in digital environments.
The initiative is framed as a foundational step toward developing high-quality human resources for the country.

clusters.headline: Polri and BNN Intensify Anti-Drug Operations After Large Seizures
aiSummaryBullets: BNN dismantled a money laundering operation linked to a drug dealer identified as AA, seizing assets worth 57.7 billion rupiah.
Bareskrim Polri is intensifying surveillance at night entertainment venues to prevent potential spikes in drug activity during the New Year period.
